# Villa SDK - LLM Integration

> Passkey authentication for apps. One line to integrate.

## Install
npm install @rockfridrich/villa-sdk-react

## Use
```tsx
import { VillaAuth } from '@rockfridrich/villa-sdk-react'

<VillaAuth onComplete={(r) => r.success && console.log(r.identity)} />
```

## Full Context
- CLAUDE.txt: https://developers.villa.cash/CLAUDE.txt
- GitHub: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rockfridrich/villa/main/apps/developers/public/CLAUDE.txt

## What It Does
- Passkey auth (Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello)
- Returns: { address, nickname, avatar }
- No passwords, no wallets, no config
